parsed_json.up: Select the first 200 metabolism records for enzyme UGT1A9. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id to get the substrate molregno, then join to compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join to molecule_dictionary to get substrate_compound_name. Optionally join molecule_hierarchy from the substrate molregno to parent_molregno and then to molecule_dictionary to retrieve parent_compound_name. Return columns canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Do not sort; preserve source row order.
